answer: An adversary running 71 aliases hence needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in karst, expire in atlas, and lantern lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4397 identities would post 1775 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
